_comment: The one source for the Hippocampus mark. Read by brand/Mark.tsx for the interface, and by scripts/render-brand.py for the app icon and the menu-bar template. Nothing else may draw the brain. A 24x24 box; the brain sits in a side profile facing left, because a mirrored front view is the construction of a heart glyph and that is exactly what the two previous marks turned out to be.
_essential: The three strokes that make it a brain rather than a cloud, together with the twelve bumps of the outline: one long central sulcus, the cerebellum tucked in at the back, and a stem that leaves off-centre. There were five for a while — the two extra folds turned the inside into a maze at every size that mattered.
_strokes: strokeSmall is used below smallSize, where a 1.3 stroke turns to mush after the downscale and macOS's antialiasing. The tray bitmap this replaced learned the same lesson with single-pixel gyri notches that looked fine zoomed in and vanished at real size.
